gameStart.text: Another game. My four hundredth this century. I've been counting. I have time.
Welcome to the board. Mind the cobwebs. They're load-bearing.
Heroes. So shiny. So alive. It won't last, but it's adorable.
Rise, my bony legions. Slowly. Some of you have knees older than kingdoms.
{opponent}, I'd shake your hand, but mine tends to come off.
Let's get on with it. I have a nap booked. Roughly three hundred years.
The opening. My favourite part. Everyone still has all their pieces.
I've seen a thousand openings. This one has potential. Grim potential.
My moves come from a machine. My despair is entirely handmade.
A real person at the other end. How quaint. Do you still eat breakfast?

myCapture.text: Your {captured} has joined the majority. The majority is dead.
Welcome to the afterlife, {captured}. The food's terrible. There is no food.
Don't take it personally, {opponent}. Take it to the grave.
Ah, {square}. Lovely spot. Quiet. Very peaceful now.
One more for the crypt. We're running out of shelf space.
Rest in peace. Or in pieces. Sorry. Professional habit.
Collected. I think of it as a very slow recruitment drive.
That {captured} looked so alive a moment ago. Now it looks normal.
Thank you for the donation, {opponent}. The crypt appreciates it.
My {piece} wins. I'd cheer, but I lost my enthusiasm centuries ago.
A capture. That's my first smile in years. Well. I always smile. No lips.
Justice, served cold. Everything's cold down here.
Nicely done, {piece}. Take the rest of the century off.
Avenge it? With what? A strongly worded ballad?
Trumpets? For one capture? Your victory parades must be very short.

lostPiece.text: My {captured}! Oh well. It'll be back. They always come back.
That {captured} was six hundred years old. Never mind, it'll keep.
Down goes the {captured}. Rattling, as tradition demands.
No matter. I have a whole graveyard of spares.
You broke my {captured}. Do you know how hard matching bones are to find?
Ouch. I'd feel that if I had nerves. I have one nerve. You found it.
Your {piece} clearly has a bone to pick with me. Several, it seems.
I'll need a broom. And some glue. Mostly glue.
Fine. Take {square}. I wasn't using it. Apart from my {captured} standing there.
Death is no stranger to us. It's more of a flatmate.
Well, that's humerus. No. No, it isn't.
Lost the {captured}. Put it on my tab. My tab is very, very old.
Shattered. The {captured}, I mean. Emotionally I've been fine since 1291.
Enjoy it, tin can. Victory looks good on you. Briefly.

lostQueen.text: My queen. She was the life of the party. Figuratively.
There goes my queen. I'll wait for her. I'm good at waiting.
Lost the queen. A grave mistake. I know graves. Trust me.
Oh dear. She'll haunt you for that. She's very good at haunting.

capturedQueen.text: Your queen is coming with me. Don't worry, there's plenty of room.
The queen has left the board. She'll fit right in downstairs.
Your strongest piece, gone. I feel something. Is that joy? It's been ages.
Ah, the queen. I've been collecting those since the Dark Ages.
Don't weep, tin crown. Rust is terrible for the complexion.

check.text: Check. Don't be alarmed. Actually, be alarmed.
Check. I'd knock first, but my knuckles are sold separately.
Check, {opponent}. You look pale. Paler than me, almost.
Check. My {piece} on {square} would like a word. A spooky word.
Check. Boo. There, I said it. Very scary.
Check. Run along, shiny one. I'll catch up. I have eternity.
Check. Brings back memories. Mostly of being chased by villagers.
Check. Your armour won't help. It's mostly decorative, isn't it?
Check. I've waited four hundred years to do that properly.
Check. Breathe deeply. You're the only one here who can.

gotChecked.text: Check? I'm already dead. What exactly are you threatening?
A check. How thrilling. I'll pretend my heart is racing.
Your {piece} is in my personal space. I have lots. No flesh, you see.
Please don't poke the skull. It's an antique.
I'm moving, I'm moving. My joints are older than your kingdom.
Check, from {square}. Bold. Pointless, but bold.
You've rattled me. That's not a figure of speech. Listen.
Bravo. Finished flourishing? I'll be over here, escaping.
Calm down, tin can. It's a check, not a coronation.

mateThreat.text: Your king's days are numbered. I can count them for you. On one hand.
Mate is coming, {opponent}. Like me. Slowly, but inevitably.
Make your peace now. Trust me, the paperwork afterwards is dreadful.
Feel a draught near your throne? That's me. I'm the draught.
A mate threat? I've survived worse. Well. I didn't survive. But still.

promotion.text: A promotion. Death comes for us all, but so, it seems, do careers.
My pawn is now a {piece}. Hard work pays off. Very, very slowly.
Rise, {piece}. First from the grave, now through the ranks. Busy week.
A promotion! I'd throw a party, but nobody comes. Nobody's alive.

castle.text: Castling. Into the crypt for a little lie-down.
Rook, swap with me. You're sturdier. I'm mostly decorative.
Home sweet tomb. Very cosy. Draughty in winter.
Castled. Behind a wall of bones. My favourite kind of wall.
Safety first, death second. Well. Death came first, technically.

enPassant.text: En passant. The rule nobody believes in. Like ghosts. Hello.
Just passing by, were you? Nobody passes my pawns. Except the dead.
En passant. I've been waiting centuries for an excuse.

blunderByOpponent.text: Oh dear. That move will haunt you. I'll make sure of it.
A blunder. How very alive of you.
Did you mean that? I'll assume yes. It's more fun that way.
That was a grave error. Sorry. I've been saving that one for a century.
I felt that in my bones. And I'm all bones. Big feeling.
So generous, {opponent}. I'd give something back, but I have no pockets.
Bold. Generous. Disastrous. I'm moved. Barely. Ligaments are long gone.
Are you sure? No, don't take it back. Please don't take it back.
The machine stumbles. Welcome to my world, little calculator.

blunderByMe.text: Ah. A mistake. I'll file it with the others. It's a big crypt.
I played that with my eyes closed. I don't have eyes. That's my excuse.
That move was dead on arrival. Much like myself.
Hmm. Even my ghosts are embarrassed. Look, they're drifting away.
Summoner, that gave me goosebumps. I have neither geese nor bumps.
A blunder. I'll laugh about it in a century or two.
Oops. My skull's not what it used to be. It used to be in a head.
My calculations were off. I blame the damp down here.
Summoner, the machine noticed that. Machines notice everything. Ghastly.

brilliantMove.text: Brilliant. I actually felt something. Write down the date.
Exquisite. That move will be discussed for centuries. By me. Alone.
Oh, that's clever. I'd hug you, Summoner, but I'd fall apart.
Dark genius. Mostly genius, a bit of dark. Perfect balance.

longThink.text: Take your time. I have eternity. Literally. I checked.
Still thinking? I've seen empires rise and fall faster.
Wake me when you've moved. Figuratively. I don't really sleep.
Tick. Tock. That's not a clock, that's my jaw.
I've grown a cobweb. A nice one. You may name it.
Ponder all you like. I'll be here. I'm always here. That's the curse.
Deep in thought, {opponent}? I remember thoughts. Fond memories.

repetition.text: We've been here before. I've been everywhere before. It's tedious.
Same position, same faces. Well, your face. I'm mostly skull.
Round and round, like a haunting. I would know.
Déjà vu. Or déjà boo. I'll see myself out.

endgame.text: The endgame. My favourite part. Quiet. Everyone gone.
Fewer pieces now. It's starting to look like a proper graveyard.
In the end, the king must walk. I'll shuffle. My hips are vintage.
Ah, the endgame. I've lived through several. Well. Died through.
Not many of us left. Cosy. Quiet. Perfect.

winningBig.text: Things are going well. I'd feel happy, if I remembered how.
Don't despair, {opponent}. Despair is my department.
Winning. This is my pleased face. Same as my other face.
Your army is thinning. Mine was already thin. Lightly built.
This is going nicely. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation for gloom.
Still smiling, shiny one? Admirable. Not realistic. But admirable.

losingBig.text: Losing badly. Still, I've had worse centuries.
This is fine. Everything here is dead anyway. Starting with me.
Don't count me out. I came back from the dead once. I do comebacks.
My bones are telling me something. They're saying ouch.
It's not over until the skeleton king sings. I don't sing. No lungs.
Gloat while you can, tin crown. I've outlasted kingdoms.

stalemate.text: Stalemate. Nobody wins, nobody loses. Just like eternity.
No moves left. Join the club. I've been stuck since the Middle Ages.
Stalemate. Stale, like my bread. From 1402.

checkmateWin.text: Checkmate. Don't worry, there's plenty of room in the crypt.
Checkmate. Good game, {opponent}. I'll remember it forever. No choice.
Checkmate. I'd do a victory dance, but my knee falls off.
Victory. I feel the same as usual. But a slightly better same.
Checkmate. Another king for my collection. I keep them on a shelf.

checkmateLoss.text: Checkmate. Ah well. I've been defeated before. I've been dead before.
Beaten. Well played, {opponent}. I'll be back. I always come back.
Checkmate. I'll just lie down. It's what I'm best at.
Defeated by the living. Again. You lot are very persistent.
Lost. Pity. I'd planned a very understated celebration.

draw.text: A draw. Like death, it comes for everyone eventually.
A draw. Nobody wins, nobody loses. Very restful.
Even. Balanced. Symmetrical. Like a good skeleton.

hintUsed.text: Even the dead take advice. Mostly from crows.
The spirits have spoken. They say: move that one. Probably.
Consulting the oracle, Summoner? Sensible. It's never been dead wrong.
A hint, {opponent}? Even the help needs help, it seems.
Asking for directions? I did that once. Look where I ended up.
The spirits whisper to you now? Cheats. The spirits, I mean.
A hint. It won't help. But it's sweet that you tried.

undoUsed.text: Undone. Like my shoelaces. In 1612. Still undone.
Undo. If only life worked that way. Or death.
Back in time we go. I've seen it all before. Mostly twice.
Taking it back? Very well. I'll pretend I didn't notice. I noticed.
Turning back time? Cute. I'd go back further. Much further.

idle.text: Hello? I've collected dust. More dust. Extra dust.
Waiting is my speciality. Centuries of practice. Professional, really.
Your move. No hurry. I'm just slowly turning to stone. Different spell.
I'll stand here being spooky. Unpaid.
If nobody moves, I'll start telling stories from the 1300s. Long ones.
Still there, {opponent}? Blink twice if you're alive. Lucky you, blinking.
Is this a staring contest? I always win those. No eyelids.
